**GameFerry.exe** is the app and **ferry.exe** the command line. Each is a single portable file for 64-bit Windows 10 and 11: download it and run it, with nothing to install. Both need an NKit 1.4 folder for its Redump and recovery files; see [Requirements](https://github.com/Fr33dan/GameFerry#requirements).

The files aren't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time one runs. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. `SHA256SUMS.txt` holds their checksums.

The web version needs no download: https://fr33dan.github.io/GameFerry/
